question: the U21 TPS61023 accessory boost is DEAD on this board -- both its SYS input edge and its ACC_5V_LX switch node are open.  What holds each, at what width, and what does opening it cost?

the_pocket_is_sealed_at_every_width.instrument: evidence/d680-pocket-width-ladder.py -- floods maze3d.Field's own free map from the BQ25185_SYS trunk on the OUTER layers, with a through-via move wherever Field.via_ok is set
the_pocket_is_sealed_at_every_width.verdict: UNREACHABLE AT EVERY ONE.  L4.1's land is FREE on B.Cu and is not reachable: the U21/L4 pocket is a closed room, and it is closed by ROUTED COPPER, not by width
the_pocket_is_sealed_at_every_width.note: so --trunk-floor, the netclass width and the D-185 2.19 A peak ruling are all beside the point for this edge; none of them opens it

the_minimal_opening_is_two_0p200_mm_sign.instrument: evidence/d680-pocket-eviction-flood.py -- the same flood under screen_corridor_blockers.Without, so the eviction it reports is the eviction route_maze_batch --evict executes

cases.FB + EXT_SCL_BUF: OPEN -- trunk reached on BOTH F.Cu and B.Cu

the_minimal_opening_is_two_0p200_mm_sign.verdict: the wall is exactly TWO 0.200 mm signals -- ACC_5V_FB's B.Cu vertical at x = 56.1-56.2 and EXT_SCL_BUF's B.Cu vertical at x = 56.65-56.85 -- and it is a JOINT wall: neither alone moves it

join_max_mm_is_also_the_wavefront_budget.instrument: evidence/d680-route-join-budget.py -- calls maze3d.route_join directly on the evicted board
join_max_mm_is_also_the_wavefront_budget.why: route_maze_batch line 3609 derives the wavefront budget from --join-max-mm as max_mm*MM/G steps, so a bound that reads as an ELECTRICAL length cap silently starves the search: at --grid 50000 a 30 mm cap is 600 wavefront steps.  Four gate runs reported NO_PATH for a join that exists.  --join-max-mm 0 is what asks the question
join_max_mm_is_also_the_wavefront_budget.consequence: every earlier NO_PATH on this board taken under a --join-max-mm bound is a REFUSAL OF THE BUDGET and not of the board

the_edge_closes_and_the_gate_passes_it.the_sys_copper_is_good: 18.883 mm at 0.800 mm with 2 vias, from L2.1 (57.715,18.400) south-east along the west of the community-header field to L4.1's own land at (57.625,34.750) -- a clean wide rail

and_it_is_REFUSED_ANYWAY.why: the collateral, which no gate clause scores.  --evict-whole re-routes /01_POWER_TREE/ACC_5V_FB at 78.759 mm with 5 vias, around the TOP of the board and across In2, for a net whose three lands span 7 mm.  ACC_5V_FB is the TPS61023's feedback node driven by a 732 k / 100 k divider; 78 mm of high-impedance trace with five layer changes beside a switching converter is not a feedback trace, and no DRC rule says so
and_it_is_REFUSED_ANYWAY.verdict: DRAWN, GATED 15 of 15, NOT PROMOTED -- an engineering refusal, recorded so nobody promotes it by accident

and_the_pocket_holds_two_of_the_three.instrument: --detour-spec: keep FB and EXT_SCL_BUF LOCAL and re-lay only the two B.Cu chains that wall the pocket, between their OWN ends, around discs reserved on the SYS lane (evidence/d680-fb-buf-relay-spec.json)
and_the_pocket_holds_two_of_the_three.why: both relays NO_PATH at 0.200 mm once the lane is reserved, in all three
and_the_pocket_holds_two_of_the_three.and_the_budget_was_re-asked: sysM raises the detour budget to 60 mm because this decision's own section 3 says a refusal under a max_mm is a refusal of the BUDGET until it is re-asked.  It is not: the verdict does not move
and_the_pocket_holds_two_of_the_three.verdict: the pocket carries TWO conductors of the THREE that want it

escape.instrument: evidence/d680-lx-escape-probe.py -- maze3d.pad_escapes for U21.5 at neck reaches 0.00 / 0.30 / 0.50 / 0.80 mm
escape.why: the TRUNK width is 0.600 mm (SWITCH_NODE netclass; the DRU prices no current for that class so --trunk-floor refuses the descent to its 0.400 mm floor).  A 0.600 mm trunk needs its launch at x >= 59.257 to clear U21.4 and U21.6, and at x <= 59.086 to clear C65.1's land.  THE WINDOW IS EMPTY.  No neck licence can help: the neck must END where the trunk can START, and with C65 where it is there is nowhere

the_measured_C65_destination.still_owed: the move strands ACC_5V_RAW's whole chain back to U21.6, and apply_part_shift refuses a --release whose closure ends ON A STATIONARY PAD.  The honest order is EVICT ACC_5V_RAW first, then shift, then route LX and RAW together with --neck --neck-reach-mm

maze3d.Neck reach.what: a necked stub may leave a named courtyard ONCE, at its last segment, by at most --neck-reach-mm
maze3d.Neck reach.why: A.intersectsCourtyard matches a TRACK OBJECT that MEETS the courtyard.  This board's own /01_POWER_TREE/ACC_5V_RAW escape from U21.6 is ONE 0.250 mm segment (58.513,40.400)->(59.023,40.400) whose copper, with KiCad's width/2 end cap, reaches x = 59.148 while U21's courtyard stops at 58.995 -- 0.153 mm outside, DRC-clean since D-597.  Neck has always demanded strict CONTAINMENT, which is stricter than the rule the board wrote
maze3d.Neck reach.default: NECK_REACH_MM = 0.0 -- strict containment, byte for byte the pre-D-680 search; every earlier measurement reproduces
maze3d.Neck reach.controls: evidence/d680-neck-reach-controls.json, all_controls_behaved true: mask_reach == mask at reach 0; the D-584 shape (a segment WHOLLY outside) still REFUSED at reach 0.5; a single exit within reach ADMITTED; the same shape REFUSED at reach 0.05; a polyline that STARTS outside REFUSED

apply_part_shift.endpoints_on layer-awar.what: an endpoint counts as ON a land only where the track's layers and the pad's layers meet -- the reading D-678 gave swept_conflicts, applied to the clause that asks the same question from the other end
apply_part_shift.endpoints_on layer-awar.measured: without it, EXT_SDA_BUF's In2.Cu waypoint at (60.300,40.800) was counted as an endpoint on C65.1, a B.Cu SMD land the whole laminate away, and REFUSED every C65 move unless a --release removed inner-layer copper the move never touches

framework.standing suite: evidence/d680-contract-regression.json -- 14/14 RAN, 13/13 COMPARABLE IDENTICAL to d678, 1 INCOMPARABLE and NAMED (pour_partition's ref_commit), all_identical_where_comparable true, vacuous FALSE

apply_part_shift --release-bare-pad.what: leave a named land with no escape ON PURPOSE, and only where NOTHING ELSE survives at that point; a surviving TRACK is still a refusal
apply_part_shift --release-bare-pad.why: --release's own help has documented this since D-678 and the clause underneath refused it.  ACC_5V_FB is a three-land chain U21.1 - R100.1 - R99.2, so moving EITHER resistor releases a closure that ends on the OTHER one's land: neither resistor of the feedback divider could be moved at all

one_resistor_opens_it.why_the_destination_is_wrong: R100.1's land ends up 0.0482 mm from /ACC_5V_BOOST_EN's B.Cu diagonal, plus one new hole_clearance and two extra solder_mask_bridge.  apply_part_shift measures ENDPOINTS and COURTYARDS; a track that merely CROSSES a moved land has neither
one_resistor_opens_it.new_instrument: evidence/d680-placement-site-clearance.py measures every land against every foreign object by SHAPE.Collide bisection -- the predicate KiCad's DRC evaluates -- and swept thirty destinations for R100
one_resistor_opens_it.what_it_found: the band south of U21 is a SIGNAL FIELD, not free area: ACC_DETECT_N, ACC_5V_BOOST_EN, ACC_5V_SW, ACC_POWER_FAULT_N and ACC_5V_ILIM cross it.  Only (59.400,41.900) and (59.900,41.900) clear 0.225 mm, and BOTH overlap C65's courtyard -- the part ACC_5V_LX needs moved
